task_description: Address KiroCrew issue #8082: MCP Tool Search deferred tools stay permanently unavailable in a session even after /compact reduces context below the deferral threshold. The deferral engine is upstream in kiro-cli (far side of the ACP boundary); KiroCrew's only lever is the per-session Tool Search overlay it writes into <work_dir>/.kiro/settings/cli.json. Implement the achievable in-repo fix: a per-session escape hatch (AcpProvider.reload_tool_search) that rewrites the overlay and restarts the kiro-cli backend so deferral is recomputed against the current post-compact context, re-injecting previously deferred specs. Document the remaining upstream-only work for a maintainer.

verification.summary: Provisioned the >=3.12 venv (Python 3.12.13) via `make backend`. Final suite `.venv/bin/python -m pytest test/test_acp_tool_search_reload.py test/test_acp_tool_search.py test/test_chat_slot_reload_tool_search.py test/test_dashboard_route_table.py -q` -> 59 passed; regression modules (reasoning-effort, chat-handlers-coverage) also pass. flake8 rc=0 and isort clean on all changed files; acp.py has only two pre-existing baseline black diffs (already in .github/black-baseline.txt), no new violations. Test quality confirmed by mutation: removing the threshold rollback in reload_tool_search's except block makes test_restart_failure_rolls_back_thresholds fail (assert 42 == 7). Semantic review v1 verdict APPROVED; its four non-blocking issues were then addressed in a follow-up (commit 330fee2): (1) restart race closed by running the check + reload under slot._lock in the new dashboard handler; (2) the lever is now reachable via POST /api/chat/slots/{slot}/reload-tool-search (api_chat_slot_reload_tool_search in chat_handlers.py, registered in routes/chat.py, mirroring the effort route) with focused route tests; (3) the ordering test now asserts the overridden overlay is written before start() is awaited; (4) threshold-override lifetime documented as intended session policy. Docker build skipped: no live kiro-cli backend in the sandbox; verification is host-side pytest with a mocked AcpClient, matching the repo's existing Tool Search test approach. Upstream-only portion (kiro-cli auto re-injection after /compact) documented in UPSTREAM_NOTES.md referencing issue #8082.
